messages.content: Explain why the sky appears blue in at least 120 words, using one concrete daytime example.
Describe how a hash table handles collisions in at least 120 words and compare two collision strategies.
Write a detailed explanation of binary search, including its invariant and time complexity, in at least 120 words.
Explain the difference between latency and throughput for an inference server in at least 120 words.
Give a step-by-step explanation of how virtual memory translates an address, using at least 120 words.
Explain RAII in Rust and why it helps resource safety, with two examples and at least 120 words.
Describe continuous batching for language-model serving in at least 120 words, including admission and decode.
Explain how a database transaction uses atomicity and isolation in at least 120 words with a transfer example.
Compare optimistic and pessimistic concurrency control in at least 120 words and state one tradeoff for each.
Explain why numerical precision matters in neural-network inference in at least 120 words.
Describe the stages of a compiler from parsing to code generation in at least 120 words.
Explain backpressure in a bounded asynchronous system in at least 120 words with a queue example.
Compare TCP flow control and congestion control in at least 120 words.
Explain how an LRU cache works and analyze its common implementation in at least 120 words.
Describe the producer-consumer problem and a bounded solution in at least 120 words.
Explain the purpose of a write-ahead log in at least 120 words, including crash recovery.
Describe how attention uses queries, keys, and values in at least 120 words without equations.
Explain the difference between prefill and decode in autoregressive inference in at least 120 words.
Describe a safe rollback protocol for partially allocated resources in at least 120 words.
Explain how profiling events can identify a GPU inference bottleneck in at least 120 words.
